posts.title: The Return of the Webmaster
posts.description: When my dear friend Pete first introduced me to web design back in the mid-90s, the term “Webmaster” was used to describe someone who was a hybrid designer, coder, and sysadmin. I narrowly missed that title (I know, gutted), but I did start out juggling Photoshop, BBEdit, Fetch, Explorer and Netscape to do my job. posts.title: Pan Sounds
posts.description: Pan ’s ten nodes resting, with sound. A node stopping plays one sound, two nodes connecting play another, and a slider sets how fast they wander.
